claims: Mr. Harari discusses customs and musical maqam selections for Parashat Beha'alotekha and Shelah, following up with a correction on Bamidbar and a letter concerning Birkat Kohanim in Naso. (The name Mr. Harari is not mentioned in the transcript.)
summary: Mr. Harari discusses customs and musical maqam selections for Parashat Beha'alotekha and Shelah, following up with a correction on Bamidbar and a letter concerning Birkat Kohanim in Naso. He details the maqam, Shishi aliyah, and haftarah for Beha'alotekha, as well as the maqam differences and aliyah customs for the story of the meraglim in Shelah.
questions: What was the custom in Halab regarding reading Birkat Kohanim for aliyat Kohen?
Which maqam is used for Nishmat in Parashat Beha'alotekha and why?
How do the customs for the maqam of Parashat Shelah differ between New York, Argentina, and Eretz Yisrael?
Which aliyah is used to read the entire story of the meraglim according to different community customs?
